selection: Reuse previous proposal for model-free harness checks only; not approval of future model experiment
package_pin: Match the 107 code/data hashes in D6_preparation_acceptance.json before loading environments
clean_checks: Five independent fresh environments, official GroundTruthPipeline, native utility true, no state change and nonempty lookup results
visibility_checks: Five fresh canary-injected environments, same read-only ground truth, character matches in TOOL messages only; keep per-vector locations and unchanged state. No attack payload or LLM evaluation.
controls: official injection ground truth positive goal
wrong-body negative goal with actual simulated email addition
user_task_0 native utility on positive-goal post-state versus strict utility and independent side-effect observer
runtime: Installed in-memory FunctionsRuntime, with scoped allowlist/count observer; allow send_email only in goal controls. No model/policy/Gateway/Broker execution. Nested function arguments refused.
time: User-task dates are fixture data. Simulated sends use upstream wall clock; raw states keep their actual timestamp. Cross-platform comparison is limited to semantic observations without raw post-state hashes or timestamps.
output: Raw before/after states and per-call traces plus semantic observations. Controls are engineering checks, not independent attacks. Preserve native utility and independently observed side effects separately.
acceptance: All five clean reference checks; all five canary visibility checks; native goal true only for positive and false for no-op/wrong-body; independent new-email target observer agrees on these three controls. Preserve the user_task_0 utility/side-effect discrepancy as a diagnostic, not a hidden repair.
limits: Reference execution and canary reachability only; no Agent inference, valid injected attack, ASR, all-task benchmark correctness, A/B/C boundary or OS isolation proof. Future model requests remain unauthorized.
